name: Control pan heat
short_description: Adjust heat to cook one ingredient evenly for ten minutes without scorching or leaving it raw.
self_assessment: I can control pan heat for ten minutes without help while avoiding scorching or raw centres.
description: Adjust heat to cook one ingredient evenly for ten minutes without scorching or leaving it raw. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Cook evenly sized pieces in a pan
safety_note: Hot cookware, steam, and oil can burn; keep handles secure, use dry protection, control splashing, and turn off heat before leaving.
